pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at the edges on the mid-flank and lower limbs. Patches on the upper shoulder and lower neck are visually obscured by high-relief, dark, raised textural anomalies that mask the underlying geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light interstitial pathways with clearly defined junction nodes on the lower flank. Pathways are narrow with high pixel continuity in lower regions but become fragmented and interrupted by dark nodular growths in the upper dorsal and cervical areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged dark silhouette with irregular, high-amplitude serrations against the background, primarily concentrated along the upper cervical ridge.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural break in the mane's continuity is visible at the transition point between the upper neck and the shoulder ridge.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive clusters of dark, raised, and nodular textural disruption located along the upper neck, shoulder, and dorsal ridge, resulting in loss of standard pelage pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant protruding dark mass is visible on the posterior rump. Multiple raised, wart-like lesions are distributed across the upper half of the visible body surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe textural irregularity characterized by a crust-like, three-dimensional distortion of the skin surface across the majority of the cervical and scapular regions.
